describe: make the writing bigger or smaller
guide: The page's writing size is font-size in the body rule of src/styles.css. The headings are sized relative to it, so change that one number.
report: The writing is $direction now: the body font size went from ${old}px to ${new}px.
I set the page's font size to ${new}px, from ${old}px. Headings grow and shrink with it.
Everything is written at ${new}px now instead of ${old}px.
teach: Most sizes on the page are measured from the body's font size, so changing it scales the page.
